title: Trailer Concrete Pump vs Boom Pump: What Pinjin Actually Sells
seoTitle: Trailer Concrete Pump vs Boom Pump | Pinjin Xingtai
description: Marketplace buyers compare trailer pumps and truck booms. Pinjin manufactures trailer and compact transfer pumps in Xingtai — not placing booms. Match Electric 15, Electric 40 and Diesel 50 printed rows instead of boom reach.
primaryKeyword: trailer concrete pump vs boom pump

answerBlock.what: A trailer concrete pump is a towed piston pump that places concrete through a steel or hose pipeline. A boom pump is a truck with an articulated placing boom. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists trailer and compact transfer pumps — not truck-mounted booms. Compare Electric 15 (8–10 m³/h, 60–80 m / 15–20 m, 450 kg), Electric 40 (21 m³/h, fine-stone 120 m / 360 m) or Diesel 50 (30 m³/h, 150 m / 450 m) against the printed table, not against boom length.
answerBlock.who: Contractors who can tow a trailer or position a compact frame and will assemble pipeline, rather than buyers who need a truck boom and outrigger pad.
factors: Whether the job is pipeline placement or boom reach
Site access for a trailer versus a boom truck
Catalogue output and H/V distance on the Pinjin model page
Pinjin does not list mixing plants or placing booms

faqs.question: Does Pinjin manufacture truck-mounted boom pumps?
faqs.answer: No. The published pump lines are trailer and compact transfer concrete pumps, mixer pumps on one trailer, spraying machines and replacement parts. Mixing plants and placing booms are not catalogue products.

faqs.question: Is a trailer pump enough for a single-family house?
faqs.answer: Match the printed house rows, not a marketplace average. Electric 15 lists 8–10 m³/h and 15–20 m vertical; Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 6–12 m³/h; the rural diesel pump lists 5–8 m³/h. An Alibaba buying-guide FAQ cites 30–60 m³/h as a typical residential band — that is a marketplace observation, not a Pinjin catalogue row.

faqs.question: Can Pinjin add a placing boom onto a trailer pump?
faqs.answer: No boom, outrigger set or truck chassis is listed. Customisation starts from a listed trailer or mixer-pump model. Unpublished boom reach is not promised.
